Explain the example for move the camera

blocks.text: The camera is the viewpoint into a scene. Moving it changes what you see without moving the object itself.

Use a browser project with the three package installed and a module build tool. Each example creates its own canvas. Run one at a time. These library imports are not supported by this site's plain runner.

items: lookAt aims the camera back at the origin where the cube is placed.

blocks.text: The camera looks down at the cube from the side and above.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: After moving the camera, aim it where you intend to look. A misplaced camera can look away from the scene.

blocks.text: Change the camera x position and compare the view.
